subject: Whenever a reading triggers existing food-handling or disposition requirements, those requirements must be applied without waiting for causal certainty or relaxing them.
rationale: The rule specifies a prospective trigger—activation of existing requirements by a reading—and a prescribed response—apply those requirements without causal-certainty delays or relaxation. Incorporating existing requirements makes the trigger and response sufficiently determinate at this scope without restating their thresholds. The decision structure is internally coherent and asserts no observed compliance or effectiveness.
